newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague bourse ends winning session on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Prague bourse ends winning session on profit-taking.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange's two-week uptrend stalled on Friday, as a round of profit-taking pushed the bourse lower for the first time since August 20.
Major issues CEZ, SPT Telecom, Komercni Banka and Ceska Sporitlena all lost ground, pushing the PX50 index down 3.1 points, or 0.53 percent, to 578.9.
Overall, decliners led advancers 184 to 169, with 87 issues trading unchanged. Total volume was average at 815,215 shares on turnover of 661.9 million crowns.
"After such a rise, this can be expected, but the bourse will probably rise again in the coming days," said one trader.
Since August 20, the PX50 index has risen about 2.4 percent.
